name: Pákozd (Hungary)
description: White field with a serrated border of red and green triangles, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Pákozd: a blue shield with a yellow drum, a crown and crossed sabres, within a wreath of oak and vine.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: serrated border of red and green triangles
